key_insight: Engineered ferroelectric domain patterns in BiFeO3 thin films strongly boost bias-free terahertz emission by changing which ultrafast photocurrent mechanism dominates.
engineering_relevance: Domain configuration is a practical design knob for optimizing compact, zero-bias THz sources with higher output and tunable emission mechanisms.
method: Compared single-domain and periodic stripe-domain epitaxial BiFeO3 thin films.
Measured THz emission amplitude and phase versus pump polarization and crystal orientation.
Separated coexisting photocurrents by symmetry to identify the dominant mechanism.
evidence_signal: The stripe-domain film produced a THz field about 4× stronger than single-domain films and reached roughly half the output of a metallic spintronic reference without saturating at the highest fluences.
watch_item: Performance depends on precise domain engineering and film orientation, so reproducibility and scalability of the domain pattern may be a practical challenge.
paper_title: Domain-engineered ferroelectric BiFeO$_3$ thin films for efficient bias-free THz emission
